meta_description: OpenDrone runs on Discord. Open a ticket here and a bot relays it into the server; replies come from the engineers who design the boards.
signed_out_intro: OpenDrone is maintained on Discord: development, community and support all happen there. This page is a terminal into that server. A bot relays your ticket into a private thread and carries the replies back here.
signin_body: One ticket, one thread. Resume from desktop or phone.
signin_reasons: We see exactly which product and firmware revision you have.
You can attach order files without typing the order number.
discord_body: The ticket form is just a relay into the same server. If you have a Discord account, skip the terminal: build questions, tuning and contributions all run in the open channels.
relay_steps: you type a message on this page
the bot posts it as a thread in Discord
an engineer answers in that thread
the bot relays the reply back to you
intake_intro: One thread per issue. Your ticket opens a private thread in the OpenDrone Discord and a bot relays messages both ways. We reply in the same window, usually within a few hours during CET business time.
field_subject_placeholder: A short title: the issue in 5 words
field_message_placeholder: Describe what you tried, what you saw, and what you expected. Logs and a short clip help a lot.
field_attachments_hint: · images, logs, video up to 24 MB
err_unreachable: Could not reach the server. Try again in a moment.
help_one_ticket: One open ticket at a time keeps things tidy on both sides.
feedback_intro: Three quick taps. Helps us figure out what to fix next.
feedback_notes_placeholder: What we got right, what we missed…
feedback_err_submit: Could not submit feedback. Try again.
